title: At sacred Lourdes, Pope Leo confronts a new reminder of the church’s sins
summary_full: Mosaics by Marko Rupnik, a Slovenian priest-artist, were covered up after at least 20 women accused him of sexual and psychological abuse. He is now on trial.
